footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Firefly Aerospace: includes a $37.1M income tax benefit; after $35.6M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.6× to $160M in 2025. Gross margin was 19.2%, versus -18.7% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $261M from $209M.
The net loss widened to $334M, or −$4.83 per share, from $266M. Operating cash flow was −$205M and free cash flow −$238M, versus −$190M.
sources: Firefly Aerospace Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
